description: Hand-crafted SVG logo/icon for Agent Harbor and its wiring into the UI, plus the app-icon regeneration documentation. Author a hand-drawn SVG (motif: harbor/anchor combined with an agent-node/network glyph, teal/blue accent, legible on both light and dark backgrounds), use it in the frontend sidebar/header, place a canonical SVG source under the Tauri icons directory, and DOCUMENT how to regenerate the raster app-icon set from it via `cargo tauri icon`. Because the Tauri CLI is unavailable offline, LEAVE the existing placeholder raster icons in place so tauri.conf.json stays valid and the build stays green; do NOT commit broken/empty icon files. Depends on FEAT-001; the sidebar wiring composes with the shell from FEAT-003.
steps: Author a hand-written SVG logo at frontend/src/assets/logo.svg: a harbor/anchor motif fused with an agent-node/network glyph (e.g. an anchor whose ring/nodes read as a small connected graph), using the theme's teal/blue accent, with a viewBox and no external references so it renders inline and on both light and dark backgrounds (avoid hardcoding a background; use currentColor or explicit fills that work on either theme). Keep it clean and modern; hand-rolled markup, not exported from a heavy tool.

Place a canonical square source SVG at crates/tauri-app/icons/agent-harbor.svg suitable as the master for raster icon generation (a square/centered composition on a solid or transparent field that reduces well to 32x32). It may share the motif with the frontend logo but should be sized/padded as an app icon.

Wire the logo into the frontend shell: import/use frontend/src/assets/logo.svg in the sidebar/header brand area introduced in FEAT-003 (inline SVG import via Vite `?raw` or as an asset, or a small Logo.tsx component). Ensure it renders next to the 'Agent Harbor' brand text and remains legible when the sidebar is collapsed and in both themes. Keep it accessible (role/img alt or aria-label).

Update crates/tauri-app/icons/README.md: document that crates/tauri-app/icons/agent-harbor.svg is the canonical logo source and that the raster app-icon set (32x32.png, 128x128.png, 128x128@2x.png, icon.ico, icon.icns) is regenerated from a high-resolution raster export of that SVG via `cargo tauri icon path/to/agent-harbor.png`. State clearly that this regeneration was NOT run in the offline sandbox (Tauri CLI unavailable) so the existing placeholder rasters remain in place and referenced by tauri.conf.json, and that regenerating the rasters is a documented follow-up. Do NOT modify or delete the existing raster files, and do NOT change the bundle.icon list in tauri.conf.json.

Update the top-level README.md with a short section: the new UI navigation/shell (left sidebar Chat/History/Settings + Settings sub-navigation + the routing-mode segmented control near Chat + dark/light theme toggle in Appearance), a note that a hand-crafted SVG logo now exists (frontend/src/assets/logo.svg + crates/tauri-app/icons/agent-harbor.svg), and how to regenerate the app icons from the SVG via `cargo tauri icon`. Do NOT bump any version or mention cutting a release.

Confirm the SVG files are valid, non-empty, self-contained markup (open and eyeball the XML). Run `NODE_OPTIONS= npx prettier --check .` from hybrid-orchestrator/frontend if any frontend TS/TSX was added for the logo wiring (prettier does not check .svg by default, but check anything it does cover).
acceptance_criteria: frontend/src/assets/logo.svg exists as valid self-contained SVG (harbor/anchor + agent-node motif, teal/blue) legible on light and dark, and is rendered in the sidebar/header brand area.
crates/tauri-app/icons/agent-harbor.svg exists as a square app-icon-suitable source SVG.
crates/tauri-app/icons/README.md documents regenerating the raster set from the SVG via `cargo tauri icon` and records that the offline sandbox could not run it, so placeholder rasters stay in place.
The existing placeholder raster icons and the tauri.conf.json bundle.icon list are unchanged (build stays green); no broken/empty icon files are committed.
README.md has a short UI/navigation note, mentions the logo, and documents app-icon regeneration; no version bump.
verification: Inspection: logo.svg and agent-harbor.svg are valid non-empty SVG; tauri.conf.json bundle.icon unchanged and the referenced raster files still exist; icons/README.md and README.md updated as described.
NODE_OPTIONS= npx prettier --check . exits 0 from hybrid-orchestrator/frontend for any covered files touched.
CI (authoritative): frontend build/lint/vitest and the per-crate tauri-app build stay green on ubuntu-latest and windows-latest (icons still valid).
